testPlan.slice: All Slices (1-6): Top Tickets with Linked Bugs
testPlan.objectives: Verify the Top Tickets with Bugs feature displays stories/tasks ranked by bug count with drill-down capability

testCases.title: API endpoint returns valid response structure
testCases.requirement: AC-2.1: API Contract

setup.action: Ensure backend server is running on port 8000

testCases.title: API validates board_id parameter
testCases.requirement: AC-2.1: API Contract

setup.action: Ensure backend server is running

testCases.title: API defaults limit to 10 when not specified
testCases.requirement: AC-2.2: List Size Configuration

setup.action: Ensure backend server is running

assert.check: Response tickets array has at most 10 items

testCases.title: API normalizes invalid limit to 10
testCases.requirement: AC-2.2: List Size Configuration

setup.action: Ensure backend server is running

assert.check: Response tickets array has at most 10 items (normalized)

testCases.title: Dashboard displays Top Tickets with Bugs section
testCases.requirement: AC-2.1: Top Tickets List Display

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard page
Ensure a board is selected

action.action: Look for 'Top Tickets with Bugs' section

assert.check: Section title 'Top Tickets with Bugs' is visible

testCases.title: Table displays ticket key, summary, and bug count
testCases.requirement: AC-2.1: Each row displays Ticket Key, Title/Summary, Bug Count

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section

assert.check: Column header for Bug Count exists
At least one row shows ticket key format (e.g., PROJ-123)

testCases.title: Tickets are ranked by bug count (highest first)
testCases.requirement: AC-2.1: List shows tickets ranked by number of linked bugs (highest first)

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section

action.action: Read bug counts from all visible rows

assert.check: Bug counts are in descending order (first row >= second row, etc.)

testCases.title: API processes 'is caused by' link type
testCases.requirement: AC-2.3: Bugs linked via 'is caused by' relationship are counted

setup.action: Ensure test data exists with bugs linked via 'is caused by'

assert.check: At least one ticket has bugs with link_type='is caused by'

testCases.title: API processes 'relates to' link type
testCases.requirement: AC-2.3: Bugs linked via 'relates to' relationship are counted

setup.action: Ensure test data exists with bugs linked via 'relates to'

assert.check: At least one ticket has bugs with link_type='relates to'

testCases.title: Bugs linked via multiple types are not double-counted
testCases.requirement: AC-2.3: Each unique bug is counted only once per ticket

setup.action: Ensure test data has a bug linked to same ticket via both link types

assert.check: Each bug key appears only once in the ticket's bugs array
bug_count matches length of bugs array (no hidden duplicates)

testCases.title: Limit selector shows options 10, 20, 50
testCases.requirement: AC-2.2: A dropdown/selector allows choosing between 10, 20, or 50 items

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section

action.action: Look for limit selector (button group or dropdown)

testCases.title: Default limit selection is 10
testCases.requirement: AC-2.2: Default selection is 10 items

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard (fresh page load)

action.action: Check which limit option is selected/active

testCases.title: Changing limit immediately updates the list
testCases.requirement: AC-2.2: Changing the selection immediately updates the displayed list

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section
Verify default limit is 10

assert.check: Table updates to show up to 20 rows

testCases.title: List respects 30-day time range filter
testCases.requirement: AC-2.4: Time filter applies to bug creation date

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard

action.action: Select 30-day time range from dashboard selector

testCases.title: List respects 90-day time range filter
testCases.requirement: AC-2.4: Time filter applies to bug creation date

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard

action.action: Select 90-day time range from dashboard selector

testCases.title: Changing time range updates list automatically
testCases.requirement: AC-2.4: Changing the time range updates the list automatically

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with 30-day range selected
Note current ticket data

assert.check: Table content refreshes without page reload

testCases.title: Clicking ticket row expands to show linked bugs
testCases.requirement: AC-2.5: Clicking on a ticket row expands to show the list of linked bugs

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section

action.action: Click on the first ticket row

assert.check: Expanded content is visible below the clicked row

testCases.title: Expanded row shows bug key and summary
testCases.requirement: AC-2.5: Each bug shows Bug Key, Bug Title/Summary

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section
Click on a ticket row to expand

assert.check: Each bug has a key displayed (format: PROJ-XXX)
Each bug has a summary/title displayed

testCases.title: Clicking expanded row again collapses it
testCases.requirement: AC-2.5: The expanded view can be collapsed by clicking the row again

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section
Click on a ticket row to expand it

action.action: Click on the same ticket row again

assert.check: Expanded content is no longer visible

testCases.title: Only one ticket row can be expanded at a time
testCases.requirement: AC-2.5: Only one ticket can be expanded at a time

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section showing multiple tickets
Click on first ticket row to expand it

assert.check: Only one expanded section is visible at a time

testCases.title: Tickets with zero bugs are not displayed
testCases.requirement: AC-2.1: Tickets with zero linked bugs are NOT displayed

setup.action: Navigate to dashboard with Top Tickets section

action.action: Inspect all ticket rows for bug count

assert.check: No row shows bug count of 0

testCases.title: Only Bug issue types are counted
testCases.requirement: AC-2.3: Only issues of type 'Bug' are counted as bugs

setup.action: GET /api/rework/top-tickets-with-bugs?board_id=1

assert.check: All items in bugs arrays are actually Bug issue types (verify via Jira if needed)
